description: As polls close and before we know any results, I just wanted to say thank you. While I wish we could've spent more time in person together, I'm thankful we connected through Facebook Lives, phone calls, and those early conversations at your doors. Over and over again, I was uplifted and reminded why I'm proud to raise my daughter in our community.

title: Before results come in - Linda Serrato for New Mexico
